course_title: Advanced clinical practicum in sports and exercise physiotherapy
course_description:
Advances student's clinical reasoning skills and evidence-informed sports and exercise physiotherapy practice.

In PHTY7968 students will participate in peer-clinical coaching and undertake a mentored sports physiotherapy clinical placement with a Titled or Specialist Sports and Exercise Physiotherapist to improve their clinical reasoning and skills, and further develop their ability to be a reflective practitioner.

course_aims: To integrate and advance students’ clinical reasoning skills, exercise prescription, clinical skills and evidence-informed sports and exercise physiotherapy practice in a clinical environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate advanced clinical reasoning, clinical skills and exercise testing and programming in the assessment, differential diagnoses and management of clients with musculoskeletal and sports injuries and conditions.
Demonstrate advanced treatment planning and goal setting for immediate and ongoing management to optimise the client's function for work, exercise and sport performance.
Demonstrate high-level understanding of client needs, inter-professional practice and indications for referral in the management of clients with musculoskeletal and sports injuries and conditions.
Integrate feedback and self-reflect on strengths and weaknesses in clinical skills and reasoning in a sports and exercise physiotherapy clinical environment.

assessment_details.task_description: Throughout the placement, students will be examined on two clinical consultation VIVAs. Initial Consultation VIVA (25%) Students will be examined on their performance of an initial consultation with a physiotherapy patient (including assessment and treatment). Follow-up Consultation VIVA (25%) Students will be examined on their performance of a follow-up treatment session (2nd or 3rd session) with a physiotherapy client. Prior to this assessment, students must prepare a written report about the assessment and treatment of the patient to date in the format outlined on Blackboard. Following the treatment session, the student will be asked questions from the examiner. The total mark for the two Clinical Consultation VIVAs must be a passing grade (60% or higher) to pass the course. This assessment task is to be completed in-person. The use of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Machine Translation (MT) tools will not be permitted. Any attempted use of AI or MT may constitute student misconduct under the Student Code of Conduct. In this course the recording of an assessment (oral/practical) performance has been waived, a record of student performance will be taken by other means such as audio recording or detailed written notes that can be referred to if a remark is required at a later date. learning_activities.topic: Clinical Reasoning Peer Coaching Students are required to complete two Clinical Reasoning Forms for patients they have seen in their clinical practice. They will meet with their assigned peer-coach on two occasions (for approximately 1 hour each) to discuss their clinical reasoning (guided by the Clinical Reasoning Form) and answer reflective questions asked by their peer-coach. They will also be a peer-coach where they will meet with and listen to their peer present their clinical reasoning (guided by the Clinical Reasoning Form) for two of their patients (each meeting will be approximately 1 hour) and ask questions to facilitate their reflection on their clinical reasoning. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04

Clinical Placement You will undertake a 2-week clinical placement in Brisbane with trained clinical educators/mentors who will help to develop your clinical reasoning and skills. The clinical placement contains clinical supervision/mentoring, as well as activities to further develop your clinical and self-reflection. During the clinical placement, you will use Clinical Reasoning Forms and Feedback Action Planning Forms to facilitate your development Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04
